scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/forward-performance-command.ts src/inference-cost-command.ts src/jev-study-export-command.ts src/backtest-command.ts src/control-study-command.ts src/gap-recovery-command.ts src/ridge-training-command.ts src/streaming-diagnostics-command.ts src/restate/restate-execution-server.ts src/restate/restate-execution-activate.ts --target=node --external tigerbeetle-node --external @platformatic/kafka --entry-naming '[name].js' --outdir=dist
scripts.test:postgres: bun test src/shadow-decision.test.ts -t "migrated cycle guard" && bun test src/execution/writer-fence.integration.test.ts && bun test src/db/broker-observations.integration.test.ts && bun test src/cycle/store/observability.integration.test.ts && bun test src/db/execution-store.integration.test.ts && bun test src/db/execution-controller-status-postgres.integration.test.ts && bun test src/cycle/store/integration.test.ts && bun test src/execution/intents/blocked-cycle-postgres.integration.test.ts && bun test src/forward-performance/postgres/read.integration.test.ts src/forward-performance/postgres/strategy.integration.test.ts && bun test src/db/streaming-snapshot.integration.test.ts && bun test src/db/research-capture-postgres.integration.test.ts && bun test src/db/jev-evaluation-postgres.integration.test.ts && bun test src/db/jev-batch-postgres.integration.test.ts && bun test src/db/jev-study-export.integration.test.ts && bun test src/db/jev-native-postgres.integration.test.ts && bun test src/intraday-replay/clock.integration.test.ts && bun test src/inference-costs-postgres.integration.test.ts && bun test src/postgres-monitoring.integration.test.ts src/cycle/store/entry-allocation-query.integration.test.ts
scripts.tsc: bun run tsc:all && bun run tsc:production
scripts.tsc:all: find ../../node_modules/.bun -path '*/@effect/tsgo-*/lib/tsc*' -type f ! -name '*.json' -exec chmod +x {} + 2>/dev/null || true; "$(bun node_modules/@effect/tsgo/dist/effect-tsgo.js get-exe-path)" --noEmit --project tsconfig.json
